Subject: Post-demo: RAG evaluation plan & next steps

Hi Tanya / Alexei —

Thanks again for your time today. Quick recap from our discovery/demo and a proposed plan for the RAG evaluation so we can validate model fit and grounding quality for Orion Medical's internal clinical KB use case.

Key notes from the call:
- Data: ~1.2M short docs (1–3 pages), mixture of policies, SOPs, and clinical guidelines; expected growth ~10%/mo.
- Primary goal: accurate, grounded answers to clinician questions with auditable provenance; hallucination tolerance = very low.
- Latency target: 350ms median for single-turn lookups; throughput target: 150 req/s sustained.
- Security: data must remain in a customer VPC for the pilot; SOC 2 evidence required.

Proposed evaluation scope (2-week pilot):
1) Retrieval baseline + reranker A/B (two paths):
   - Path A: BM25 + dense embeddings (FAISS HNSW) + no reranker (fast, cheaper)
   - Path B: same retrieval but + "redwood-rerank-1" reranker over top-200 candidates (higher precision, modest latency)
2) Models to evaluate (generation layer):
   - redwood-search-1 (large open variant, strong instruction-following)
   - redwood-mini-quant (3-bit) for a cost-sensitive baseline
3) Prompts & evaluation: use attached prompt set (orion_promptset_v1.json) + crowd/hybrid human evaluation for grounding precision, MRR, and hallucination rate.

Initial recommendations (config):
- Chunking: 2–4 paragraph chunks (~500–800 tokens) with overlap 50 tokens.
- Retrieval params: k=200 candidates, embedding dim 1536 (dense).
- Reranker: redwood-rerank-1 on top-200, return top-5. Expect ~6–12% absolute lift in grounding precision based on similar healthcare evals but CPU/GPU cost will increase.
- Grounding metrics: grounding-precision@5, MRR, and human-verified hallucination rate (per 100 responses).

Attachments: I attached the prompt set and a short benchmark summary (rag_benchmark_summary_202504.pdf). Also linking a short evaluation template: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1OrionRAGEval

Next steps I propose:
- If you confirm pilot scope, we’ll provision a private evaluation environment (VPC) and share SOC2 artifacts.
- Schedule a kickoff to align on eval checklist and sampling.
- Decide whether the early focus is on throughput (Path A) or precision (Path B).

Available to jump on a 30-min kickoff this week: https://calendly.com/dylan-brooks/30min

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

Cheers,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Alexei / Tanya — appreciate the questions. Below is a concise A/B plan and supporting numbers; happy to sync with your eng team for any deeper dive.

Empirical evidence (short):
- On a recent healthcare pilot (50k sample) we observed: baseline (FAISS+embed, top-5 gen) grounding-precision@5 = 64%, MRR = 0.52.
- With redwood-rerank-1 on top-200, grounding-precision@5 = 74% (+10pp), MRR = 0.63 (+0.11). Hallucination rate (human-verified) dropped from 8.1% to 3.9%.
- Latency delta observed: ~+60ms p50, +180ms p95 on our dedicated GPU nodes.

A/B plan (recommended pilot experiment):
- Duration: 14 days
- Sample: representative 10% KB ingest; 2k traffic-sampled queries/day (we can increase if you want faster stats)
- Split: 50/50 Path A (no rerank) vs Path B (rerank top-200)
- Metrics & decision rule (primary):
   - Grounding-precision@5 (human-verified) -> need >=+7pp improvement for Path B to justify ops/cost
   - MRR delta >= +0.08 is a strong secondary signal
   - Latency: p95 must stay <= 1s; if >1s, evaluate mitigations (reduce k to 100, use async rerank, or cache top results)
- Cost delta (rough ballpark): Path B costs ~+35–55% per 1k queries depending on model sizes and whether the reranker runs on CPU vs GPU. We will provide a detailed estimate once we know exact model variants and infra (dedicated vs hosted).

Deliverables we’ll provide for the pilot:
- Ingestion checklist & scripts for the 10% sample
- Eval harness (automated MRR and grounding-precision calc + human annotation UI)
- Weekly checkpoint deliverables with interim metrics and suggested mitigations

If you’re aligned, please reply with a short "GO" and we’ll kick off provisioning and Marissa will send SOC2 artifacts. Otherwise, tell us which part to tweak.

Thanks —
